name: ProCo RAT 2 (LM308N)
description: ProCo RAT 2 distortion, LM308N version, as drawn on the ElectroSmash 'Pro Co Rat Analysis' schematic (RAT/RAT 2 core: the RAT 2 adds the LED and keeps this circuit; later units use the OP07). Input: R1 1 MΩ pull-down, C1 22 nF, R2 1 MΩ to the 4.5 V reference, R3 1 kΩ, C2 1 nF to ground into the LM308 + input. Non-inverting gain: 100 kΩ Distortion pot as a rheostat in the feedback with C4 100 pF across it; two ground legs R4 47 Ω + C5 2.2 µF (1.54 kHz) and R5 560 Ω + C6 4.7 µF (60 Hz); 30 pF compensation capacitor C3 between pins 1 and 8 (LM308 external compensation: it sets the slew rate and gain-bandwidth, part of the RAT's sound). C7 4.7 µF, R6 1 kΩ into the 1N914 pair to ground. Filter: 100 kΩ rheostat + R7 1.5 kΩ into C8 3.3 nF (475 Hz ... 32 kHz). C9 22 nF, R8 1 MΩ into the 2N5458 source follower (R9 10 kΩ source resistor), C10 1 µF into the 100 kΩ audio Volume pot. Supply: 9 V through R10 47 Ω to the filtered +9 V node with C11 100 µF, C12 0.1 µF and the shunt reverse-polarity diode D3 1N4002; that node feeds the LM308 V+, the Q1 drain and the R11/R12 100 kΩ divider with C13 1 µF for the 4.5 V reference. True-bypass effect-on state. The output buffer Q1 is an N-channel JFET (part type 'njf', nodes [drain, gate, source]); see JFET.md.

sources.title: ElectroSmash, 'Pro Co Rat Analysis' (schematic and BOM: C1/C9 22 nF, C2 1 nF, C3 30 pF, C4 100 pF, C5 2.2 µF, C6/C7 4.7 µF, C8 3.3 nF, C10/C13 1 µF, C11 100 µF, C12 0.1 µF, D1/D2 1N914, D3 1N4002, Q1 2N5458, Volume/Tone/Distortion 100K-A, R1/R2/R8 1M, R3/R6 1K, R4/R10 47, R5 560, R7 1.5K, R9 10K, R11/R12 100K, U1 LM308; LM308 slew rate 0.3 V/µs with 30 pF; at the RAT's 67 dB maximum gain the LM308 open-loop curve limits the gain to about 30 dB at 10 kHz). Archived copy used

ElectroSmash, Pro Co Rat power-supply drawing (R10 47 Ω series from +9V Main; D3 1N4002 shunt, anode to ground, cathode on the filtered +9 V; C11 100 µF and C12 0.1 µF to ground; R11/R12 100K with C13 1 µF for +4.5 V). Archived copy read

National Semiconductor, 'LM108/LM208/LM308 Operational Amplifiers' datasheet TL/H/7758 (Dec 1994): standard compensation Cf = 30 pF, 'bandwidth and slew rate are proportional to 1/Cf', LM308 large-signal voltage gain 25 V/mV min / 300 V/mV typ, output swing ±13 min / ±14 V typ at ±15 V into 10 kΩ, supply current 0.3 mA
onsemi 2N5457/D datasheet (Rev. 6, 2010): 2N5458 IDSS 2.0 / 6.0 / 9.0 mA (min/typ/max), VGS(off) −1.0 to −7.0 V, |yfs| 1500 / 4000 / 5500 µmhos

LM308.note: LM308N with the RAT's 30 pF compensation capacitor C3 as the macro's dominant-pole capacitor (cdom = Cf, so slew = Imax/Cf as in the real part). a0 300 V/mV typ and ±14 V swing at ±15 V (1 V headroom) from the National datasheet; slew 0.3 V/µs at 30 pF as read from the datasheet graph by ElectroSmash. unverified: gbw 320 kHz is ElectroSmash's reading of the open-loop curve (about 30 dB left at 10 kHz); the datasheet gives this only as a graph. Supply: U1's V+ pin sits on the R10/C11 filtered node, so the macro runs in rail-node mode (output swing clamped 1 V from the actual V+ / V− node voltages, push-pull output drawing from V+). iq 0.3 mA = the datasheet's typical supply current. rout is left at the engine default 100 Ω: the National datasheet gives no open-loop output resistance (unverified). Not modelled: the LM308's input-stage limits, output current limit, the 1/Cf scaling if C3 is edited (C3 is folded into cdom, not a separate part)

2N5458.note: Same values as the engine's library 2N5458 (njf, SPICE level 1). Shichman-Hodges fit to the onsemi datasheet typicals: IDSS 6 mA and gm0 4 mS give |VTO| = 2·IDSS/gm0 = 3.0 V and BETA = IDSS/VTO² = 0.667 mA/V². unverified: LAMBDA 0.01 /V, IS, CGS/CGD (datasheet Ciss 7 pF max, Crss 3 pF max → assumed 4.5 p / 1.5 p zero-bias), assumed; see JFET.md. 2026-11-09: rd/rs/pb/m removed (not parameters of the engine's njf kind; the netlist did not compile with them)

controls.label: Volume
controls.note: 100 kΩ audio-taper pot after C10; wiper is the output

controls.label: Distortion
controls.note: 100 kΩ audio-taper rheostat in the LM308 feedback: gain 1 + Rdist/(47 Ω ∥ 560 Ω) above 1.5 kHz, up to 67 dB

controls.label: Filter
controls.note: 100 kΩ rheostat + 1.5 kΩ into 3.3 nF: clockwise adds resistance (darker, down to 475 Hz)

controls.label: Bass
controls.note: Legacy 'Bass' parameter; the RAT 2 has no bass control; stored only

controls.label: Balls
controls.note: Legacy 'Balls' parameter; no such control on the RAT 2; stored only

controls.label: Treble
controls.note: Legacy 'Treble' parameter; no circuit meaning; stored only

controls.label: Tone
controls.note: Legacy 'Tone' parameter (id O). The RAT 2's only tone control is Filter (id F); stored only

controls.label: Lamp
controls.note: Legacy indicator lamp (the RAT 2 LED is on the switch, not in the audio path); stored only

parts.label: +9 V Main (battery / adapter)
parts.note: Ideal source: the battery or adapter at the DC jack, ahead of R10

parts.label: Supply filter resistor
parts.note: ElectroSmash power-supply drawing: series 47 Ω from '+9V Main' to the filtered +9 V node that feeds U1 pin 7, the Q1 drain and R11. With C11 it is a 34 Hz low-pass; at ~0.6 mA it drops ~28 mV

parts.label: Reverse-polarity protection (shunt)
parts.note: 1N4002 on the ElectroSmash BOM; drawn as a SHUNT diode, anode to ground and cathode on the filtered +9 V node after R10 (reverse-biased in normal use; with a reversed supply it conducts and R10 limits the current). Library 1N4001 card used: the 1N4002 differs only in its 100 V reverse rating
